 MCC notifies key dates for AIQ, States NEET PG counselling 2026 rounds 
 Written By : MD Bureau Published On 2026-11-17T15:24:33+05:30   |   Updated On 17 Nov 2026 3:24 PM IST 
 New Delhi: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has released the AIQ and state counselling dates for NEET PG counsellling 2026.
 The schedule for NEET-PG 2026 counselling has been released for admissions under the All India Quota (AIQ), Deemed and Central Universities, and State Quota. 
 Candidates can check the detailed NEET-PG 2026 counselling schedule below:
 S.No. Schedule for Admission All India Quota/ Deemed &Central Universities Sharing of Joined candidates Data by MCC State Counselling Sharing of Joined candidates Data by state DMEs/ State Counselling Authorities 
 1. Round-1 12th Oct., 2026 to 24th Oct., 2026 3rd Nov., 2026 21st Oct., 2026 to 2nd Nov., 2026 11th Nov., 2026 
 2. Last date of Joining for Round-1 2nd Nov., 2026 _ 10th Nov., 2026 _ 
 3. Round-2 6th Nov., 2026 to 14th Nov., 2026 25th Nov., 2026 14th Nov., 2026 to 24th Nov., 2026 1st Dec., 2026 
 4. Last date of joining for Round-2 24th Nov., 2026 _ 30th Nov., 2026 _ 
 5. Round-3 26th Nov., 2026 to 4th Dec., 2026 14th Dec., 2026 4th Dec., 2026 to 12th Dec., 2026 19th Dec., 2026 
 6. Last date of joining for Round-3 12th Dec., 2026 _ 18th Dec., 2026 _ 
 7. Stray Vacancy 16th Dec., 2026 to 24th Dec., 2026 Data of allotted candidates will be shared by MCC on 24th Dec., 2026 22nd Dec., 2026 to 25th Dec., 2026 _ 
 8. Last date of joining for Stray Vacancy Round 31st Dec., 2026 31st Dec., 2026 
 9. Commencement of Academic Session for PG Courses 20th Nov., 2026 
 Following the regular rounds, the Stray Vacancy Round for AIQ, Deemed and Central Universities is scheduled from December 16 to December 24, 2026, while State counselling will be conducted from December 22 to December 25. The last date for joining seats allotted in the Stray Vacancy Round is December 31, 2026. MCC will share the data of allotted candidates on December 24.
 The academic session for postgraduate courses is scheduled to commence on November 20, 2026.
 The schedule further states that all participating institutes and colleges will treat Saturdays, Sundays and Gazetted Holidays as working days to ensure adherence to the counselling timeline, considering the limited time available for completing the admission process.
